title: MWCD Internship for Women Students & Scholars
summary: Policy and programme internship with the Ministry of Women and Child Development for women students, scholars, social activists and teachers.
eligibility: Women students (UG/PG/research), scholars, social activists and teachers. Law, social work, gender studies, public policy and allied fields are common.

prize.description: ₹20,000 per month plus travel reimbursement and hostel accommodation.

notes: The latest reported cycle closed on 10 September 2026; the ministry runs it in batches, so check for the next call.
